notes.title: Vicious Cycle has a release date!
notes.notes:
Vicious Cycle finally has a release date, which is...September 17th! 



I've been working on feverishly on new content for the final game for a while and I'm happy to finally show it all off. In fact, there's so much content that it could fill a shiny new trailer!
[previewyoutube="of1hvz8QOw4;full"][/previewyoutube]
I can't wait to see people experience Vicious Cycle. I hope you're looking forward to it too!
